name: Kenco / The Shippers Group - Jonesboro GA

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (33.5215,-84.3538, APPROXIMATE, moved 834m) pointed to downtown Jonesboro retail strip - wrong. The Shippers Group / Kenco Jonesboro is at 9250 S Main Street, Jonesboro GA 30236 (~499,960 SF ambient warehouse, food-grade per CRE listing 'Jonesboro Commerce Center'). Confirmed via The Shippers Group locations page, Waze/TruckMap listings, and a Street View pano (Aug 2025) showing the blue 'TSG' logo on the building wall. Locked center on the building footprint at 33.50560,-84.34810.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A chain-link perimeter fence is visible along the property line (Sep 2025 Street View). No barrier arm or sliding/swing gate structure was visible at the driveway connecting the site to S Main Street, and the road frontage is a heavily wooded buffer that obscures the exact entrance in Street View. truckGate marked false (fence present but no controlled checkpoint structure confirmed); flagged uncertain. The truckGate geofence box is the probable driveway-to-road junction at the SW.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at any entrance in available imagery. guardShack=false, remoteGs=false. Flagged uncertain due to wooded entrance buffer.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door banks visible along the SW and SE faces of the building with ~26 trailers backed in / parked. Counted roughly 32 doors across the truck-court faces; banded 25-50. The CRE listing cites 28 dock doors which corroborates the 25-50 band. Low-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors appear on two adjacent building faces (SW and SE) sharing one continuous truck court rather than two physically separate clusters. Treated as a single dock operation; shipRcvSeparate=false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A large paved truck court runs the length of the building's SW/SE faces holding ~26 parked trailers - a dedicated trailer-storage / drop area. dropYard=true, dropArea 25-50.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs immediately along the NE side of the building, buffered by a tree strip; no clearly visible active spur entering the footprint in imagery, but the CRE listing explicitly cites '4 rail doors'. railServed=true on the strength of the listing; flagged uncertain since the spur connection is not confirmable from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal access road and truck court are long and deep - easily holds 3+ trucks queued. postGateStaging=true (open court inside the property before docks).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: South-metro-Atlanta industrial corridor along S Main St / GA-54 with continuous development - Urban.
fieldNotes.siteArea: Perimeter box ~24 acres covering the building, truck courts, trailer parking and car parking. Approximate.
